policy_anchor_rule: first valid, first raw open-to-close (clamped to full valid chunk), last valid; deduplicate
gradient_rule: first four episodes in frozen manifest of each split, closure anchor, clean and background; effective batch8; eval mode with grad enabled; Math SDPA BF16; separate action/weighted auxiliary gradients
AE_samples: existing ten evenly spaced anchors per episode x h1..8; all matching samples
probe: fixed ridge alpha=1 on average squared loss; train clean h8,10anchors per20episodes; train-only feature zscore; validation5episodes both appearances; no hyperparameter selection
phase_rule: derived ground-state bowl lift>=.03m -> transport_or_placement; otherwise first raw closure +/-4 steps -> closure_window; earlier -> approach; later -> after_close_no_lift; descriptive only
video_rule: first seed in each appearance, five uniform C-timeline indices and corresponding clamped D times; all trials classified separately
